E_0: Amplitude of the electric field going in
I_0: Intensity of the light going in
n_1: Index of refraction on the incident side
n_2: Index of refraction on the far side
p: Component with the field in the plane of incidence
r_p: Reflection coefficient for the p component
r_s: Reflection coefficient for the s component
s: Component with the field perpendicular to the plane of incidence
theta: Angle between the light's polarization and the polarizer's axis
